name: Risaikuru
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood recycle shop (Guruguru Recycle): a notice about business hours changing, a first day working part-time at the buying counter, a usage-and-price guide, a first time helping buy a large piece of furniture, a comparison of two new-staff training plans, a column about a friend nervous the first time selling an item, teaching a new junior staff member how to check an appliance's operation, an essay on why recycle-shop use keeps growing, a temporary closure notice for store renovation, a column on tailoring assessment to different kinds of customers, a notice of revised buying rules, a reflection on the meaning of an item passing to its next owner, and a one-year cooperation report with a local welfare group. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
